QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] Arkarium, Guardian of Time
QuestInfo.0: Get back to the Silent Crusade Hideout and tell Bastille about everything that's happened in Leafre!
QuestInfo.1: Crow found something. See if he'll tell you what he's worked up about.
QuestInfo.2: New information seems to have confirmed sightings of Arkarium, one of the Black Mage's Seven Commanders! Eyewitnesses place him at the Temple of Time, though his current whereabouts are unknown. Something sinister is at hand!

0.0: The Black Mage's servants are controlling the monsters behind the Mystic Gates...
0.1: This is definitely part of his evil plan, but there must be some goal he's trying to achieve! This can't just be to cause a little bit of chaos.
0.2: Keep pushing ahead. This thing's going to break and we need to be ready when it does.

npc.0: Crow looked upset, what's going on? Are you two having a fight?
